canonical_term: VIZ English Black Clover, Vol. 1 witness
definition: Selected VIZ English digital Volume 1: Shonen Jump imprint, 193 pages, eISBN 978-1-4215-9077-6, released 2016-06-07.
cultural_caution: The accessible VIZ product page credits story and art to Yūki Tabata but does not identify an individual English translator.

supports: Edition, imprint, length, eISBN, release date, and author credit.

definition: VIZ describes Asta as born with no magic ability in a world where magic is everything.
cultural_caution: A fictional magical premise only; it must not be equated with real-world disability, diagnosis, class, or marginalization without separate evidence.

supports: Asta's no-magic premise and magic-centered world.

definition: The title Asta seeks as the greatest mage in the land.
cultural_caution: An aspirational fictional office, not a real royal, religious, or occupational equivalent.

supports: Asta's aim to become the Wizard King.

definition: VIZ's official Volume 1 review calls the book Asta receives a grimoire, or magic book, and connects it to his magic-negating sword.
cultural_caution: The review does not establish a complete grimoire taxonomy, a universal ritual, or a generic artifact equivalence.

supports: Grimoire/magic-book wording and connection to the unusual sword.

canonical_term: friendly rivalry and church upbringing evidence boundary
definition: Official coverage identifies Asta and Yuno as best friends/rivals and says they were raised at a church. It does not label them orphans, establish formal social class, or license real-world institutional analogies.
cultural_caution: Church upbringing and rivalry are narrative facts in a fictional work, not a basis for religious, orphanhood, or class mapping.

definition: This pass covers only VIZ's English Volume 1 product and its early official supporting references. Anime, films, games, novels, guidebooks, later volumes, and adaptations require separate continuity passes.
cultural_caution: No adaptive scene, characterization, power claim, or later-series revelation is imported here.

supports: The selected source is a single Volume 1 product rather than a franchise-wide witness.
